name: Volumetric Inverse Rendering with Differentiable Path Tracing
aliases: Volumetric Inverse Rendering with Differentiable Path Replay Backpropagation
Volumetric Path Tracing with Adjoint Differentiation
definition: A technique to optimize a 3D volume density (extinction/scattering) stored on a regular grid to match a set of synthetic reference images. It accounts for direct and indirect illumination by using path replay backpropagation to compute derivatives of delta tracking and volumetric multiple scattering.
summary: Volumetric Inverse Rendering with Differentiable Path Tracing optimizes a 3D volume grid to match reference images by treating density as trainable parameters and using path replay backpropagation for gradient computation.
